description: Split a PDF into parts by page ranges such as '1-2,5-' or every N pages, returned as one PDF or a zip of parts. Cost in credits: ceil(pages written / 20), minimum 1. File input (file): base64 string, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}. Output: a file (application/pdf | application/zip) returned inline, at most 1 MiB. part_01.pdf when there is one part, otherwise split.zip holding part_01.pdf ...; meta: {parts, page_count}

every_n.description: Alternative to ranges: parts of this many pages.

file.description: The PDF: base64 string (or data: URI) or {"url": "https://..."}. Up to 10 MB.

ranges.description: Comma-separated page ranges, one part each: '1-2,5-' ('5-' runs to the last page).

name: pdf_split
title: PDF splitter
